title: Mailbox/query args
description: Arguments for Mailbox/query (RFC 8621 §3.3). Returns an ordered list of Mailbox ids matching a filter.

accountId.description: The account to query mailboxes from.

filter.description: Filter conditions. Supported properties: parentId (MailboxId|null), name (String), role (String|null), hasAnyRole (Boolean), isSubscribed (Boolean).

sort.description: Sort criteria. Each Comparator has a property (e.g. name, sortOrder) and optional isAscending (default true).

position.description: 0-based index of the first result to return.

anchor.description: A MailboxId to anchor the result page at.

anchorOffset.description: Offset from the anchor (may be negative).

limit.description: Maximum number of ids to return.

calculateTotal.description: If true, return the total number of matching mailboxes.
